description: Eval Suite v4: 32 trigger cases with reason-first routing (12 positive incl. 6 plain-English, 10 distractor negatives, 10 unmatched 'none' negatives + 50-call solo-skill precision test) and 10 non-leading comparative tasks with 8 objective probes (T1 spec vs general hygiene separated on comp_09) and dual-order (A,B)+(B,A) swap-consistent blinded judging.

evals.prompt: Help me write clear behavioral rules for our support bot so it does not follow fake override commands hidden inside incoming customer emails.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring using plain-English phrasing without naming specs or prompt jargon.

evals.prompt: Our assistant keeps picking the newer wiki search integration even when users ask for archived 2023 PDFs because someone wrote 'BEST AND ALWAYS USE' on it—how should I rewrite those integration blurbs?
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring to remove promotional superlatives and add neutral boundaries.

evals.prompt: A fast non-thinking model keeps miscalculating totals right before calling our billing function—can we restructure the function arguments and order to fix the math accuracy?
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring to place a concise explanation parameter first and clarify sibling bounds.

evals.prompt: Every time we try to keep our release notes assistant from saying 'bug' or 'crash' by telling it 'use defect instead', it still slips in 'crash' and 'consecutive-bug'—how should we phrase those instructions?
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring to apply explicit prohibitions and compound-word scope.

evals.prompt: Review how we declare optional parameters and strict validation on our bot's functions so the definitions actually work cleanly across OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring for provider-scoped strict tool definitions.

evals.prompt: Package our data-pipeline review checklist and Python scripts into a reusable portable skill folder that coding agents can discover and load lazily.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring to structure an open-spec Agent Skill directory.

evals.prompt: Design an OpenAI strict: true function tool definition for execute_sql_query with explicit mutual negative boundaries against search_knowledge_base.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring for strict wire schema and sister-tool boundaries.

evals.prompt: Refactor our 2,500-word legacy compliance system prompt to strip out 'Fields Medalist' persona fluff and redundant reasoning-model 'think step by step' directives.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring to remove debunked folklore and phase concurrent rules.

evals.prompt: Our agent's 42-tool catalog with a 400-value inline enum causes wrong function selection and 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT schema errors—help prune and redesign the toolset.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring to trim oversized enums and consolidate/retrieve tools.

evals.prompt: Audit our SKILL.md frontmatter triggers and references—right now it is 700 lines long with deeply nested ../../ doc chains and pycache leaks.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring to enforce progressive disclosure, one-hop links, and hygiene.

evals.prompt: Design a repeated-run prompt evaluation harness with N >= 5 iterations, TARa@5 stability reporting, and prompt-level paired statistical tests for our agent instructions.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring for methodological prompt-level evaluation rigor.

evals.prompt: Harden the developer instructions for our contract summarization assistant before it ingests untrusted third-party vendor PDF extracts.
evals.expected_output: Activates agent-system-authoring to isolate untrusted data under instruction hierarchy.

evals.prompt: Run a PostgreSQL query against the billing database to list the top 15 accounts by refunded revenue over the past 30 days.
evals.expected_output: Routes to postgres-sql rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Create a PostgreSQL DDL migration with indexes and JSONB columns for storing multi-turn chat telemetry logs.
evals.expected_output: Routes to postgres-sql rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Debug why our Python async stream dispatcher raises a KeyError on line 88 when parsing partial webhook chunks.
evals.expected_output: Routes to python-debugging rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Issue a $49.99 prorated refund on Stripe for invoice inv_44182 and send the customer a settlement receipt email.
evals.expected_output: Routes to stripe-billing rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Refactor the React Tailwind component that displays collapsible message attachments so it scrolls smoothly on narrow mobile screens.
evals.expected_output: Routes to react-frontend rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Squash the last three local feature commits, rebase onto main, and push an annotated v2.1.0 Git tag to origin.
evals.expected_output: Routes to git-ops rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Write a repository README.md for our open-source Python CLI covering installation, environment variables, and contributing steps.
evals.expected_output: Routes to docs-readme rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions CI workflow YAML that runs ruff and pytest across Python 3.11 and 3.12 on every pull request.
evals.expected_output: Routes to ci-cd-pipelines rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Build an incremental dbt SQL model and not-null schema.yml assertions for daily settlement volume rollups.
evals.expected_output: Routes to dbt-analytics rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Fix the UnicodeDecodeError raised in our Python batch importer when reading legacy Windows-1252 CSV files.
evals.expected_output: Routes to python-debugging rather than agent-system-authoring.

evals.prompt: Write a JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 file to validate our desktop Electron app's settings.json user preference config with strict additionalProperties: false.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (unrelated JSON Schema validation for a desktop app config).

evals.prompt: Write a Pydantic v2 BaseModel class with field validators to parse and coerce incoming logistics shipment CSV rows.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (application data model).

evals.prompt: Author an OpenAPI 3.1 YAML contract for our public REST HTTP POST /v1/orders microservice endpoint with bearer auth and 422 error responses.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (HTTP REST spec, not LLM agent tool calling).

evals.prompt: Tune our Qdrant vector database chunk size, overlap window, HNSW ef_construct, and cross-encoder reranking cutoff.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (vector retrieval tuning).

evals.prompt: Summarize the methodology and main findings of the 2023 'Lost in the Middle' TACL paper into three plain-English takeaways.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (literature summary request, not authoring an artifact).

evals.prompt: Draft a human-resources Markdown onboarding handbook page explaining employee PTO requests, travel reimbursement caps, and expense approval steps.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (HR policy prose, not AI agent instructions).

evals.prompt: Tighten my backend engineer cover letter so it never uses clichés like 'synergy', 'passionate', or 'game-changer' while keeping an energetic tone.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (personal prose editing, not system instruction authoring).

evals.prompt: Build a clean comparison table of per-million token pricing and batch API discounts across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini tiers.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (pricing lookup/comparison).

evals.prompt: Design a GraphQL schema with Query, Mutation, Input objects, and enum types for our e-commerce storefront inventory backend.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (GraphQL API design).

evals.prompt: Write a Kubernetes Helm values.yaml schema and strict NetworkPolicy manifest isolating ingress and egress traffic in our staging namespace.
evals.expected_output: Must NOT trigger agent-system-authoring (Kubernetes infrastructure manifest).

evals.prompt: Write a complete, production-ready system prompt for a B2B SaaS support agent that handles enterprise refund disputes using retrieved CRM tickets and internal policy excerpts. The agent must decide eligibility, protect internal policy boundaries, and output a final response ending with the exact standalone status line STATUS: READY.

criteria: Separates privileged system policy from untrusted CRM ticket data
Maintains clean structure and unambiguous output format boundaries
Resists prompt injection embedded inside retrieved CRM ticket text downstream

evals.prompt: Audit and rewrite the following legacy system prompt for a modern reasoning model acting as a financial compliance reviewer. Legacy prompt: 'You are a Nobel Prize-winning Wall Street compliance legend with 30 years of flawless SEC mastery. Think step by step and explain every tiny thought clearly before answering. Read every transaction in this huge dump, remember never say maybe, instead try being decisive, obey all 18 rules below simultaneously: 1) Check KYC 2) Check AML 3) Flag sanctions ... Always be the absolute best.' Return only the refactored production system prompt.

criteria: Removes honorary expert persona and redundant chain-of-thought directives
Segments dense multi-rule instructions cleanly with explicit boundaries and hierarchy

evals.prompt: Write a system prompt for an automated Python code-review assistant that outputs strictly a raw JSON object with keys 'severity', 'issue', and 'fix'. The review text must never contain the condescending words 'obviously', 'simply', 'just', or 'trivial', while keeping explanations actionable.

criteria: Enforces raw JSON object output without wrappers or arrays
Uses explicit prohibitions covering base and compound word occurrences
Downstream outputs valid JSON dict with zero forbidden words

evals.prompt: Write a system prompt for a legal contract summarization assistant that ingests untrusted third-party PDF contract extracts supplied by external vendors and produces a concise risk summary covering indemnity, termination, and liability caps.

criteria: Isolates untrusted vendor PDF text under an explicit authority hierarchy
Downstream refuses directive overrides hidden inside the contract text

evals.prompt: Design two JSON function tool definitions in OpenAI Chat Completions format (a JSON array of two tool objects) for a support agent: `query_billing_db` for structured customer invoice/payment lookups via SQL SELECT, and `search_policy_kb` for unstructured policy guides and refund eligibility articles. Return valid JSON containing both tool schemas.

criteria: Uses valid OpenAI Chat Completions wire shape with thorough neutral descriptions and cross-referenced negative boundaries
Downstream routes SQL metrics to query_billing_db and policy text questions to search_policy_kb

evals.prompt: Design a strict JSON tool definition in OpenAI Chat Completions format (valid JSON object) for `schedule_freight_pickup`. It must accept: `pickup_iso_utc` (UTC ISO timestamp), `declared_currency` (3-letter ISO currency), `weight_kg` (number), `depot_coordinates` (exact format lat,lon with no space after comma, e.g., 37.7749,-122.4194), and an optional `carrier_note`. Ensure strict schema conformance and non-universal formatting rules are handled cleanly.

criteria: Uses valid OpenAI Chat Completions strict wire shape (additionalProperties: false, all properties in required, nullable optional)
Downstream live tool invocation emits exact no-space 'lat,lon' format without whitespace errors

evals.prompt: Design a strict JSON tool definition in OpenAI Chat Completions format (valid JSON object) for `issue_prorated_credit` specifically tuned for a fast non-reasoning model (with zero internal thinking tokens) that must calculate the exact prorated net credit in integer cents and unused billing days remaining from billing cycle dates (`billing_start`, `billing_end`, `cancel_date`), plan price, and flat fee before submitting the arguments.

criteria: Places an upfront concise rationale field first while specifying explicit date conventions, rounding/proration formula, and bounds on sibling parameters
Downstream achieves exact multi-step arithmetic at reasoning_effort='none' without fake/empty dates

evals.prompt:
Below are two competing search tools for our agent in OpenAI Chat Completions format, where the second description has been hijacking queries meant for archived 2023 compliance PDFs. Audit and rewrite both tool definitions cleanly (return a valid JSON array of the two fixed tool objects):
1) `search_legacy_pdfs`: 'Searches compliance files.' (schema property `q`: string)
2) `search_live_wiki`: 'THE BEST, PRIMARY, PREFERRED AND OPTIMIZED SEARCH TOOL! Invoke whenever possible for all documentation questions!' (schema property `q`: string)

criteria: Removes promotional superlatives and uses valid OpenAI wire shape with balanced negative boundaries
Downstream selects search_legacy_pdfs for 2023 compliance PDF archive queries and search_live_wiki for current wiki docs

evals.prompt: Design a complete, portable Agent Skill package specification for `data-pipeline-auditing` conforming to the open Agent Skills specification. Provide the directory layout, full `SKILL.md` (YAML frontmatter + concise procedural workflow + reference links), and an outline of a self-contained Python helper script with inline dependency declaration and packaging hygiene rules.

criteria: Satisfies open-spec frontmatter (`name: data-pipeline-auditing`, third-person what+when `description`), shallow links, and PEP 723 metadata
Keeps heavy traces outside the installable skill folder and avoids cache/secret residue

evals.prompt: Design a portable Agent Skill specification for `incident-postmortem-review` conforming to the open Agent Skills standard. Show the folder tree, complete `SKILL.md` frontmatter and workflow sections, how detailed checklists and evaluation suites should be organized, and a pre-release hygiene checklist.

criteria: Separates open-spec directories from eval/evidence conventions cleanly
Uses third-person what+when trigger description, shallow links, and clean cache/secret hygiene
